author: Jim
content: Hello there. As a child to adolescent I could hear the stars sing. The conditions had to be just right - winter, bitter cold, snow, so dark you could see the Milky Way. Can't happen now, you're lucky to make out the brightest stars. Can hear it in my head now though; it sounded like a heavenly choir singing one long, loud note.

author: Jim
content: Just had an afterthought. No, it wasn't tinnitus! lol! I suffer from that now, and believe me, that wasn't it. lol!
